text.p: -- Prudential Securities analyst Alex Henderson said in a research note that he raised his earnings estimate and target price on Consolidated Graphics Inc after it was reported the company will earn between $0.38 and $0.40 per share in the second fiscal quarter, an outlook Henerson said "scorches" his previous $0.32 per share estimate.
-- Henderson said he raised his earnings estimate for the fiscal year ending March 1997 to $1.50 per share from $1.45 and raised to $0.38 per share his estimate for the second fiscal quarter.
-- He also said he raised his 12-18 month target price on the stock to $50 per share from $40, "but we see an upside to $60 if all goes well."
-- Consolidated shares were up 2-1/4 to 30 in late Friday Nasdaq trade.
